- `.githooks/pre-commit` is executable POSIX shell. It runs frontend checks and Rust Clippy.
- Local Git configuration currently sets `core.hooksPath=.githooks`, so adding executable `.githooks/commit-msg` activates it alongside pre-commit.
- `README.md` and `Makefile` contain no hook setup instructions or installation target.
- Smallest integration is a standalone POSIX shell hook reading the first line from `$1`, plus README setup instructions and an executable regression script using an isolated Git repository. No package dependencies or Makefile changes are needed.
- Header validation should accept custom types, optional scope, optional `!`, and a nonempty description. Avoid an invented type allowlist.
